visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler wearing a striped shirt and a blue pacifier crawls across a white foam play mat in a brightly lit indoor living room. In the background, an older bald man in a black T-shirt and a woman in a yellow shirt sit on a large gray sofa, looking toward the toddler. (2) An older boy, roughly 6 years old, enters the frame and stands in front of the bald man on the sofa. He gestures with his hands while speaking animatedly to the man, who looks confused and slightly amused. (3) The camera shifts to a close-up of the toddler's face as he sits on a person's lap, smiling with the pacifier in his mouth. (4) The older boy reappears, now wearing dark sunglasses and a yellow jacket over his black shirt. He holds a small orange toy microphone and sings with exaggerated facial expressions, tilting his head back. (5) Multiple shots show the bald man's reaction; he leans back on the sofa, scratching his head and looking bewildered by the boy's singing. Yellow variety-show style text captions pop up around the screen. (6) The boy finishes his performance with a deep bow towards the camera, smiling proudly. The man in the background continues to look at him with a mix of surprise and laughter.
